description: Defines models, enums, styles, and CSS generation logic for customizable widget buttons in a UI component library.

classes.name: ButtonStateCssGenerator
classes.description: Abstract class for generating CSS for different button states, with subclasses for specific states.

classes.name: EnabledButtonStateCssGenerator
classes.description: Generates CSS for the enabled state of the widget button.

classes.name: HoveredButtonStateCssGenerator
classes.description: Generates CSS for the hovered state, including color darkening effects.

classes.name: PressedButtonStateCssGenerator
classes.description: Generates CSS for the pressed state, including ripple and fill color effects.

classes.name: ActivatedButtonStateCssGenerator
classes.description: Generates CSS for the activated state, with color darkening.

classes.name: DisabledButtonStateCssGenerator
classes.description: Generates CSS for the disabled state, using default disabled colors.

methods.name: generateStateCss
methods.description: Creates CSS variables for a button state based on appearance and custom styles.

methods.name: getMainColor
methods.description: Retrieves the main color for the button, defaulting if not specified.

methods.name: getBackgroundColor
methods.description: Retrieves the background color for the button, defaulting if not specified.

methods.name: generateAdditionalStateCss
methods.description: Generates additional CSS for specific states, overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: generateWidgetButtonAppearanceCss
methods.description: Generates full CSS for all button states based on appearance.
